lines.text: I told him the truth. And every one of me looked *up.*
lines.style: Young man, shouting in a whisper, fast and raw, terrified by what he sees.

lines.text: Don't say the line. There is no Floor Zero. It's *me.*
lines.style: Young man, speaking into a headset mic, urgent and shaking, pleading, the last word a confession.

lines.text: The girl stopped smiling. And looked straight at *me.*
lines.style: Young man, hushed horror, slow, the last word barely breathed.
Young man, quick and sharp, a gasp after a bang.

lines.text: You went off script, Theo. This floor isn't the *top.*
lines.style: Deep, cold, very slow voice over an old intercom, no longer polite, almost a whisper, ancient and amused.

lines.text: Then the ceiling opened, and a ladder came *down.*
lines.style: Young man, whisper, slow and careful, awed.
Young man, tense, quick, turning around.

lines.text: Down on twelve, the new me was alone with *her.*
lines.style: Young man, fast panicked whisper, rising dread.
Young man, panicking, fast and desperate, torn between two choices.

lines.text: Comment *A* or *B.* You decide where I go.
lines.style: Young man, urgent and direct, speaking straight to the viewer, pleading but steady.

music.title: Floor 0 - The Truth
music.style: Horror thriller score. Starts instantly on a sharp stinger and a held breath, hundreds of quiet electronic tones freezing, a cold detuned music box, a glass bulb bursting into a deep sub boom, a vast low drone with a whispering intercom texture, metal groaning above, a slow rising string swell of awe, then racing heartbeat and ticking to a sudden cut. Instrumental only, no vocals, mixed to sit under a voiceover.
